priceSnapshot.note: THE RANGE LOW HELD A FOURTH TIME, BY 27 POINTS. Midnight marked 62,585.2 with a bearish tilt and named 62,284.3 - the 1 August low - as the line that had never been closed through. Price went straight for it: the 04:45 COT 15m candle printed 62,311.3, which is 27.0 points and 0.043% above that low, and stopped. It then reclaimed 62,410, reclaimed 62,585 within thirty minutes, and ran to 62,864.5 by 05:45 COT before fading back. That sequence - tag the shelf, reclaim on a 15m close - is the exact pattern midnight published as its next add trigger and as its scalp instruction ('a tag that immediately reclaims 62,585 is a long'). It fired 305 points higher than the level midnight laddered it against. Spot is now 62,582.6, which is 2.6 points BELOW the midnight mark: five hours of range, a 553-point round trip, and net zero. Session range measured from the 02:00 COT midnight snapshot is 62,311.3 - 62,864.5.

Today it was approached to within 27.0 points and rejected. What makes a break different now is what sits underneath: the current CoinGlass surface puts 706.23K of liquidation leverage at 62,204.7, only 79.6 points below the invalidation and 76.6% of the colour maximum. A 4H close beneath 62,284.3 therefore does not land in a vacuum - it lands on the heaviest measured band on the entire visible surface, and the next real shelves after that are 61,862.45 (280.01K) and 61,451.75 (156.47K). Expect the break, if it comes, to be violent and fast to 62,205 and then to hesitate.

decisionBox.changed: FIVE things changed versus the 2026-08-03 midnight report. ONE: the invalidation was tested and held. 62,284.3 has now survived a fifth probe and a FOURTH consecutive session as the published reduce level without ever being closed through on a 4H basis; today's 62,311.3 is the closest approach yet. TWO: 15m momentum has turned. RSI has climbed from 28.12 to 42.43 and the 15m MACD histogram has crossed POSITIVE at +17.68 from -18.49, and it did so while the price close made a marginally LOWER low than the midnight bar - a textbook bullish divergence, logged in divergences[]. THREE: the 4H histogram went the other way, crossing NEGATIVE at -10.66 from +9.63, so the two timeframes now disagree and the range read is the honest one. FOUR: the liquidation surface has REBUILT LOWER and much heavier. Midnight's dominant band was 432.17K at 62,410.05; the 06:00 column now reads 706.23K at 62,204.7 - 76.6% of the 921.97K colour maximum, the single brightest feature anywhere near spot - and it sits 79.6 points BELOW the invalidation. The 62,410 band that dominated midnight has decayed to 72.24K at 62,341.6. FIVE: macro moved BTC-friendly across the board while price did nothing. Brent is 83.09, down 5.50%, the 10-year fell 7.6bp to 4.669%, DXY eased to 99.726, and US equity pre-market is bid - VOO +0.43% and JPXN +2.12% at 08:07 EDT. Every cross-asset input rotated risk-on overnight and BTC did not take it. That non-participation is the single most important thing in this report and it is why the tilt goes to bullish only cautiously and the confidence stays under 6.

liquidityMagnet.note: The pull is DOWN and this time it is not a close call. 706.23K sits 0.60% below spot at 62,204.7 against 44.84K at 62,889.2 above - a 15.7-to-1 asymmetry in weight, versus midnight's near-even 432.17K/373.31K. What still argues AGAINST simply leaning short on that gravity is positioning: 48.51/51.49 keeps the crowd net SHORT for a second straight session, so a meaningful share of the fuel at those lower bands is short-side stops that pay on the way back UP, and open interest ROSE 1.38% overnight while price went nowhere, which is fresh positioning being added into a range rather than anyone capitulating. Gravity and fuel still point opposite ways. The practical read is unchanged from midnight and was validated today: the tag is the event, not the direction - what happens in the fifteen minutes after 62,204.7 is touched decides whether 62,284.3 holds a fifth time.

atr.source: Computed here (Wilder ATR-14) from Kraken XBTUSDT daily OHLC over 61 sessions through the in-progress 2026-08-03 UTC candle, seeded on a 14-bar simple average of true range then Wilder-smoothed. Math: TR = max(H-L, |H-Cprev|, |L-Cprev|), then ATR = (ATRprev x 13 + TR) / 14. ATR has EXPANDED again, from midnight's 1,555.69 to 1,581.55 (+1.7%), a second consecutive expansion, because the in-progress 2026-08-03 candle has now covered 63,587.2 - 62,311.3 = $1,275.9 with twelve UTC hours still to run. At 2.53% of spot a normal day covers about $1,582. This number is what keeps the desk out of futures: 62,582.6 down to the 62,284.3 invalidation is 298.3 points, or 0.19 ATR, and even a stop under the 62,204.7 magnet is 377.9 points or 0.24 ATR - both far inside the half-ATR floor the 1 August lesson set for leveraged risk.

calibration.rollingRecord: The midnight report got the LEVELS and the SCALP right and the tilt marginally wrong, which is the mirror of endday. Its reduce level at 62,284.3 did not fire - price came within 27.0 points and rejected, a fifth successful defence. Its scalp note said the tag of the lower magnet 'is the event, not the direction' and that a tag which immediately reclaims 62,585 is a long; that is exactly what happened at 04:45 COT, and the reclaim paid 553 points to 62,864.5. What it got wrong was the level the pattern would fire at - it laddered the next add against 61,999.35 and the market executed the same pattern 305 points higher, at 62,311.3, which meant the reserved cash never got used at the planned rung. And the bearish tilt at 26/40/34 did not earn anything: five hours later spot is 2.6 points below the midnight mark. Scored strictly: level work right for a fifth session, pattern recognition right, price target for the pattern too low, tilt immaterial.
calibration.note: Two things to carry forward. FIRST, laddered add triggers are being anchored too deep. Twice now - 1 August at 62,284.3 and today at 62,311.3 - the tag-and-reclaim has fired at the RANGE LOW rather than at the heaviest liquidation band beneath it, because the band is where the stops sit, not where the buyers sit. The rule should anchor the first rung at the structural low and only the second rung at the liquidation shelf. This report does that: the core added at 62,582.6 after the reclaim, and the remaining dry powder is laddered at 62,204.7, not deeper. SECOND, and more uncomfortable: BTC did not participate in a broad risk-on rotation. Brent -5.50%, the 10-year -7.6bp, DXY -0.19% and JPXN pre-market +2.12% is a clean set of tailwinds, and BTC's answer was to go nowhere for five hours. An asset that will not rally on good news is usually telling you about supply, and the ETF tape is the obvious candidate. Watch today's Farside print before trusting any upside continuation.
